# Odette Pullen

## Overview

- **Gender:** female  <sub>[v1 c21 P2](../source/v01-c21.md#nw-v01-c21-p0002), [v2 c26 P59](../source/v02-c26.md#nw-v02-c26-p0059)</sub>
- **Status:** alive  <sub>[v4 c2 P10](../source/v04-c02.md#nw-v04-c02-p0010)</sub>
- **Origin:** Brierley  <sub>[v1 c33 P6](../source/v01-c33.md#nw-v01-c33-p0006), [v3 c8 P18](../source/v03-c08.md#nw-v03-c08-p0018)</sub>
- **Role:** former schoolteacher  <sub>[v1 c37 P34](../source/v01-c37.md#nw-v01-c37-p0034), [v2 c4 P0](../source/v02-c04.md#nw-v02-c04-p0000), [v3 c11 P0](../source/v03-c11.md#nw-v03-c11-p0000), [v3 c18 P3](../source/v03-c18.md#nw-v03-c18-p0003), [v4 c2 P10](../source/v04-c02.md#nw-v04-c02-p0010)</sub>
- **Nicknames:** Mrs. Inglis  <sub>[v4 c2 P10](../source/v04-c02.md#nw-v04-c02-p0010)</sub>

## Appearance

Odette is a tidy, practical, and unadorned young woman with a plump, rosy face and small hands. At her lavish wedding, she wore white satin, tulle, lace, roses, orange blossoms, and a large cluster of diamonds that nearly obscured her from view.

_Sources: [v3 c2 P4](../source/v03-c02.md#nw-v03-c02-p0004), [v3 c39 P20](../source/v03-c39.md#nw-v03-c39-p0020), [v3 c39 P27](../source/v03-c39.md#nw-v03-c39-p0027), [v3 c41 P9](../source/v03-c41.md#nw-v03-c41-p0009), [v4 c2 P10](../source/v04-c02.md#nw-v04-c02-p0010)_

## Personality

Odette is unassuming, composed, hardworking, steady, and sensible. She maintains an unshakeable, practical, and pragmatic demeanor, facing challenges with quiet dutifulness. She possesses a gentle, tranquil disposition and a pleasant, ladylike nature. Though not exceptionally clever or witty, she is unpretentious, well-liked, and careful never to speak words that would hurt others.

_Sources: [v1 c31 P30](../source/v01-c31.md#nw-v01-c31-p0030), [v1 c32 P18](../source/v01-c32.md#nw-v01-c32-p0018), [v1 c35 P6](../source/v01-c35.md#nw-v01-c35-p0006), [v2 c4 P8](../source/v02-c04.md#nw-v02-c04-p0008), [v2 c26 P59](../source/v02-c26.md#nw-v02-c26-p0059), [v2 c26 P60](../source/v02-c26.md#nw-v02-c26-p0060), [v3 c2 P4](../source/v03-c02.md#nw-v03-c02-p0004), [v4 c2 P10](../source/v04-c02.md#nw-v04-c02-p0010)_

## History

Odette grew up in Brierley as the daughter of Gorham Pullen. She attended school alongside Nell Harcourt, Isolde Pembroke, and Opal Pettigrew, with whom she formed the Story Club. After passing her entrance exams with remarkable composure, she attended Regent's Academy and distinguished herself by winning top marks in domestic science. Upon graduating, she secured a position as a schoolteacher in Stonebridge, where she earned a place on the Inspector's Roll of Honor, though she privately found teaching tedious. While residing in Brierley, she actively participated in the local Improvement Society (B.V.I.S.), serving on committees alongside her peers. During a winter break, she reluctantly agreed to act as a messenger for her shy brother Barney to propose marriage to Nell, which Nell declined. After leaving her teaching post in Brierley, Odette traveled West to teach at a prairie school. While out West, she met Mr. Inglis, a wealthy Englishman, whom she married in late May in a splendid wedding. Following her marriage, she remained unpretentious, happy, and affectionately connected to her old friends.
